question: Guru Bipin Singh was conferred the Kalidas Samman Award for which form of dance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manipuri**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Guru Bipin Singh was an acclaimed exponent and choreographer of the **Manipuri dance**, one of the major classical dance forms of India.
 
• He was instrumental in popularizing Manipuri dance both within India and internationally.
 
• Manipuri dance is characterized by its lyrical and graceful movements, often depicting themes of love and devotion.
 
• The Kalidas Samman is a prestigious arts award given annually by the government of Madhya Pradesh, recognizing exceptional contribution to classical music, dance, theatre, and visual arts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Manipuri Dance**

 
 
• Originated in Manipur, a northeastern state of India.
 
• Known for its themes based on the Raas Leela and the love story of Radha and Krishna.
 
• Costumes are often vibrant with the female dancers wearing the traditional "Patloi" and "Kumin" attire.
 
• Music accompanying the dance includes traditional Manipuri instruments such as the Pung (drum) and Kartal (cymbals).
 
 
 
• **Kalidas Samman Award**
 
 
• Named after the classical Sanskrit author Kalidasa.
 
• One of the highest awards for arts in India, instituted in 1980.
 
• Awarded annually by the Government of Madhya Pradesh, Department of Culture.
 
• Honors outstanding achievement in the fields of classical music, classical dance, theatre, and visual arts.
 
 
 
• **Guru Bipin Singh**
 
 
• Regarded as a pioneer in the field of Manipuri dance.
 
• Founded the Manipuri Nartanalaya in Kolkata and Imphal.
 
• His contributions include choreographing numerous dance-dramas and training many prominent dancers.
 
• Recipient of several prestigious awards including the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award.
